historicalRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and the sphere blocking spells of fifth level/Tier 5 or lower. NEW the operative measure is the original generating spell's actual rank 0 through 5; Tier here means spell rank, not material tier, class level, RP paid or a name-based estimate. An actually authorized rank-changing source uses its real generating rank; discounts/surcharges alone change no rank. Preserve the original conflicting terminology and Instantaneous metadata. NEW create one fixed 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range/line of effect, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. It is nonphysical, supplies no cover/support/collision and does not follow its caster.

NEW block a qualifying spell's new local application to a creature/object/point inside the globe when that component's genuine authorized origin is outside the globe at resolution. Use the actual originating body/legally authorized remote source, not arbitrary animation graphics or the target's position as a fabricated origin. Origin on the boundary counts outside; a recipient intersecting the protected interior is protected as a whole discrete body/item. Outgoing spells from inside and spells genuinely originating inside remain legal, including against inside recipients. An outside-to-outside spell path can pass through without protecting its outside recipient; this is a recipient ward, not an opaque antimagic wall. A spell's nonspell costs/casting commitments and concentration still occur; blocking its payload gives no refund or retroactive Counterspell.

For multi-target spells, prevent only qualifying protected recipient applications. Other targets remain independently legal. An outside-origin instantaneous area can resolve elsewhere, but its protected interior recipients receive no damage, condition, healing, teleport-arrival or created object/body application from that low-rank component. A genuine arrival originating outside is checked at its destination: a protected destination leaves the transported body at its actual origin under the transport source's ordinary failure rule, without free retargeting. This is not a general planar rule. A created summon outside can later move inside physically; its already-created real body does not become a new cast on every step. Its source-defined ordinary nonspell attack is not automatically blocked merely because a low-rank spell created it.

Existing creature-attached buffs/curses and completed instantaneous changes are not dispelled, suspended or ended when the globe forms or a bearer walks in. An already-established externally anchored ongoing area of rank 0-5 has only its covered local ongoing expression blocked while the globe applies; original concentration, duration, spent ticks and exterior effects continue. No queued pulse on leaving/expiry. A genuine new reapplication counts as new, not as protected historical work. Spell-granted intrinsic weapon enchantments remain established benefits; a newly triggered independent spell payload with its own actual originating interface is checked separately, without converting the entire physical weapon hit into a spell. Nonspell class abilities, ordinary projectiles, magical item engines and rank6+ spells are unaffected unless their actual source expressly makes them eligible spell components.

The globe itself is rank6. An outside lower-rank attempt aimed at its protected anchor is blocked even if that attempt would otherwise have a higher-rank dispel procedure; an inside eligible dispel, rank6+ source or actual explicit ward-bypass permission retains its scope. A spell that expressly ignores spell blocking overrides only this barrier component, not cover or unrelated legality. Suppression removes the globe's local protection while the original clock runs; it does not suppress every protected creature's unrelated magic. Concentration ending, expiry or actual removal ends it. Multiple globes supply the union of their operative protected volumes, no stronger rank ceiling; adjudicate origin/recipient against each separately. One active globe per caster, with normal concentration commitment and successful replacement rules. No hidden spell-rank or effect inventory is reported to the caster.
workedCases: AC6-01-A: An outside caster uses an actual rank5 multi-target spell against one creature inside the globe and one outside. Only the inside recipient's new application is blocked. The paid RP, cadence and concentration remain committed. A rank6 spell is not reduced to rank5 because its caster received an RP discount, and a surcharge on rank5 does not let it bypass the globe.

AC6-01-B: A creature walks into the globe with an existing low-rank buff and an existing curse; both retain their source procedures. An externally anchored low-rank damage field has its covered local expression blocked, without losing its outside portion or pausing expiry. A genuinely inside-origin spell can still affect inside targets. Ending the globe does not discharge all missed periodic damage at once.

Resolve which spell-rank measure governs and distinguish class level,material tier and paid/upcast rank without quietly rewriting the source. Supply sphere geometry,placement,movement,duration/concentration and what blocking does to casts originating outside,inside or crossing its surface. Define effects already present,ongoing areas,creatures with buffs,projectiles,damage riders and nonspell magical features. State whether a whole spell is prevented or only its effects on protected recipients,how multi-target casts split,and how explicit immunity-bypassing spells interact. Costs and concentration remain committed under actual casting rules; no universal magic cancellation or retrospective resource refund is inferred.

historicalRecord.procedure:
KEEP both Abjuration/Universal placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/M-or-F and concentration up to one minute, filling an area with multiple defensive spells. NEW choose one perceived fixed center and a 20-foot-radius sphere with center line of effect. At casting name up to three actually perceived willing creatures within range, optionally yourself, as recognized passers for this cast. This list cannot change later, grants no allegiance/identity credential and is not selected from hidden membership. The following three explicitly NEW constituent spells form one rank-six cast and shared concentration, rather than free castings of Arcane Lock, Fog Cloud or Warning Ward from the catalog.

CLOSURE WARD: choose up to three actual nonliving closed doors/lids/gates entirely within the area and visible to the caster at resolution. No suitable closures simply means no closure targets; the other two constituents still form. Each selected closure is magically secured. A recognized passer can open/close it normally if the underlying physical locks/permissions also allow that act. Another creature can use an Action for STR (Athletics) or, with actual suitable trained thieves' tools, the appropriate DEX tool task against the original spell DC. Success/Critical Success permits that one opening without removing the ward; failure spends the Action, and a new actual forced-opening effort can try again as this explicit repeated physical-task permission. Ordinary locks remain their distinct actual Action/DC15 procedure; defeating the magic alone does not undo them. The ward does not close an open occupied door, crush a body, increase object HP, repair damage or create a door in empty space. Moving/destroying the real closure outside the field ends only its ward participation.

VEIL WARD: the operative field heavily obscures normal vision through its interior for unrecognized observers. Recognized passers see through this specific veil using ordinary sight, not through actual darkness, smoke, Hidden creatures or walls. This is a magical visual veil, not physical fog or an illusory depicted scene; True Seeing's ordinary illusion/darkness permissions alone do not remove it. A genuinely applicable broader sight source can work. The veil creates no physical cover, removes no known location and adds no separate Invisible condition. Entering/leaving does not preserve a benefit beyond the live field or turn an unrecognized observer into a recognized one.

WATCH WARD: when an unrecognized creature first actually crosses from outside into the live field in a numbered round, including forced movement or a genuine teleport arrival, it emits a six-elapsed-second ordinary visible outline while inside this field. Occupants already present at creation are not entry events; reentry during the same caster/target/Guards-and-Wards round cannot restart the outline, including through replacement casts. The outline marks actual visible position through this ward's own veil but not through physical walls, and supplies no attack modifier, alignment/identity report or remote alarm to an absent caster. It does not remove a separate actual Invisible condition for unrelated sight-required purposes. A creature may leave and reenter during its original outline interval, resuming only the still-live remainder. No save, damage, Action denial or hard-control claim is supplied by these three layers.

Each constituent keeps one parent cast/rank/owner/DC/deadline. Ordinary dispelling of the addressable Guards and Wards source ends all its remaining layers; no separate three Counterspell windows, charges or concentration records exist. A source explicitly able to bypass/remove one selected magical lock/visual marking can affect only that actual component, without regenerating it through the parent. A removed individual closure ward stays removed for this cast. Local suppression suspends only actual intersecting expressions and clocks continue. Missed entries during suppression never queue a future outline; resumption is not entry. Expiry, concentration ending or actual parent removal ends all surviving layers, without repairing/breaking physical doors or curing other sources. One parcel per caster; a newly formed parcel replaces the old under the normal concentration procedure. There is no permanent secure building, unattended attack engine, free spell repertoire or additional work crew.
workedCases: AC6-02-A: The ward encloses two closed real doors and no third eligible closure. Both receive the closure layer; the visual veil and entry-watch layer still exist. A recognized ally must still handle a genuine underlying mundane lock. An unrecognized creature spends an Action and succeeds at the ward task against DC16; that opening is allowed, but the ward remains for a later closing.

AC6-02-B: An unrecognized foe enters, receives the six-second outline, exits and is pushed back inside in the same numbered round. No second outline duration or damage appears. The marker can show its actual position through this ward's veil, but does not reveal a creature through stone or create a remote identity report. Removing the single parent spell ends all three defensive constituents.

Do not substitute a single AC bonus or import a fixed external-game list; every chosen constituent must be identified as a source binding or explicit NEW authoring. Components,activation and13RP are not permission to repeatedly cast any spell for free,grant permanent buildings or bypass class access. historicalRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and an area damaging creatures of specified alignments; preserve Instantaneous as incomplete metadata. NEW choose one perceived center within range/line of effect and one to three complete alignment pairs from the nine combinations of Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic and Good/Neutral/Evil. These are selection categories in the current canonical two-axis system, not judgments created by this spell. The choice is fixed for the cast. Create a stationary 20-foot-radius sphere, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, with center line of effect. No planar travel prohibition, sacred ground, permanent consecration, faction restriction or creature-type exclusion is added.

At formation, and on later actual creature regular STARTs inside or actual entry into the live field, the Director privately compares the recipient's current actual mechanical alignment record with the selected complete pairs. Both actual axes must be recorded and exactly match a selected pair; an unknown axis is not guessed from behavior, ancestry, faith, faction, corruption or appearance. A genuinely applicable active alignment overlay participates under its own source rules. Protection that specifically prevents this source from using alignment for its predicate prevents the matching application within its stated scope. A Divination-only information protection does not automatically block this Abjuration damage spell, and the spell does not reveal the protected data to its caster. No valid recorded match means no damage attempt, not a public declaration of neutrality or alignment.

Each matching exposed creature makes WIS against the original spell DC for NEW 3d8 force damage, half rounded down on success. Roll one shared raw amount for recipients at the same actual event; different genuine later events can roll again. No radiant/necrotic or deity preference is inferred. Across all Forbiddance applications/casters, each target has at most one save/damage opportunity per numbered round, including creation; choose the earliest eligible operative source for simultaneous overlaps. Record the exposure before the save/damage so immunity, success or prevention does not grant another attempt. Initial nonmatching eligibility consumes no exposure, but a later genuine alignment change requires an actual future START/entry event, not an immediate extra pulse. Forced movement and teleport arrival can constitute actual entry, without extra damage from repeatedly crossing in one round.

Outside initiative, formation can have its eligible first pulse and later occupants have six-second spell pulse opportunities using the same shared interval exposure. Map the next unresolved periodic opportunity to the next actual regular START on entering initiative, without an additional transition pulse. An owner-attached recipient uses its real regular attached-phase start for this stated spell-only tick; if no phase exists the original six-second spell schedule continues without creating an Action/turn. Suppressed opportunities are spent without queued damage; suppression ending is neither entry nor START. No hard-control claim, compelled conduct, movement barrier or continuing damage condition is added.

The source supplies no readout of who matched, saved, was immune or had an unknown/protected alignment. Ordinary actually visible effects remain observable and may support ordinary inferences; the spell does not guarantee secrecy against observation or authorize an additional alignment diagnostic. Leaving the area stops further eligibility without ending the field. Concentration loss, expiry, removal or a newly formed same-caster replacement ends it under the actual source rules. All ordinary damage consequences remain after ending, with no permanent alignment change, historical rewrite, extra corpse effect or claimed cosmology.

One creature has actual Lawful Evil recorded and makes WIS; a 3d8 result of17 becomes8 on success before defenses. AC6-03-B: A matching creature enters two overlapping Forbiddance fields. Its one named-family opportunity is resolved from the earliest eligible source; being pushed out/back cannot produce a second opportunity that round. An actual later alignment overlay can change future eligibility, but does not retroactively undo prior damage or trigger damage immediately without a new START/entry event.

historicalRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, locking one magical effect in place and preventing dispelling by normal means. Preserve Instantaneous metadata. NEW select one individually perceptible ongoing magical application with a discrete spatial origin/area and actual dispel interface, perceived within range/line of effect, owned by you or explicitly permitted by its actual current source owner/controller. A fixed effect can qualify even if it currently has no movement permission. A permanently creature/carried-object-attached effect is excluded rather than immobilizing its bearer. A class engine, whole creature, permanent item enchantment without a separate eligible ongoing application, completed instantaneous result or nonexistent aura is not a target. No rank cap or resistance roll is added once those real permissions are present.

NEW maintain one nonconcentration Seal for up to seven elapsed days, ending earlier when the protected application ends. Fix that application's spatial origin at its actual current world position. It loses authorized relocation/recentering while sealed, but keeps its actual source-permitted radius/shape evolution and unrelated effects; anchoring is not a frozen event clock or expanded shape permission. The parent's owner, rank, DC, concentration, duration, recipient set, charges, pulses, resource history and ordinary source-ending permissions remain. A one-minute parent still ends after its original minute. The Seal neither maintains another caster's concentration nor prevents their voluntary ending, source destruction, legitimate expiry or an independently specified non-dispel ending.

Normal dispelling cannot end the protected application or this Seal itself while protection operates, including an otherwise eligible Greater Dispel. A source explicitly overriding nondispellable/anchored protection retains only its real written scope; no high-rank automatic bypass is invented. Counterspell can stop the Seal before establishment. Actual suppression is distinct: it suspends the Seal's protection/anchor while the original seven-day clock continues. A separately legal dispel can then affect an otherwise eligible parent or Seal only if it can actually resolve through that suppression environment and its own normal rank/target rules. This creates no permission to cast inside antimagic or assume that a low-rank dispel can remove a rank-six Seal. If a mobile parent moves while the Seal is suppressed, on resumption the Seal fixes its then-current origin, not a backward teleport to the old point; this is a NEW specific resumption rule, with no renewed duration or lost-history reset.

One active Resonance Seal per caster. A genuinely established new Seal replaces that caster's old one, freeing the old parent's movement/ordinary dispel eligibility without ending it. Hidden failure/countering creates no replacement. The caster may end their Seal with an Action while personally perceiving its anchor within60feet and line of effect. Separate other casters' Seals retain their own original deadlines; fixing the same origin supplies no cumulative protection rank or added duration. A genuinely conflicting attempt to establish a second origin for an already immovable effect does not move that effect; its current actual position is the only admissible anchor.

NEW exclude Resonance Seal, Spell Seal and Resonance Anchor themselves from this spell's eligible targets, preventing cross-protection loops among these three families. Propose the corresponding cross-family exclusion for the earlier unadopted Spell Seal; that earlier proposal remains preserved, and this is an explicit amendment requiring joint review. Reviewed Resonance Anchor is unchanged and keeps its own normal dispellability. Compared with the distinct proposed Spell Seal, Resonance Seal has actual spatial anchoring, source-owner permission, one active caster slot and a seven-day maximum; Spell Seal proposes broader application targeting and a24-hour nondispel-only benefit. Neither is silently merged or renamed. No body, RP, charge, missed pulse, old effect or frozen lifetime is created by either name.

The field can no longer move but still needs its original caster's concentration and ends on its original minute deadline. The seven-day Seal therefore ends with it. An attempt to protect the whole caster or freeze a creature-attached buff in space is ineligible under this explicitly proposed target rule.

AC6-04-B: The Seal is suppressed while its still-live parent moves lawfully to a new origin. On resumption before the original deadline, the proposed anchor fixes that current position; it does not teleport the field back or restart seven days. A new paid Seal can replace the caster's old Seal but cannot target another Seal/Anchor to build an unlimited protection loop. Those cross-family choices await joint review.

historicalRecord.procedure:

The criterion is an actual current canonical mechanical source expressly identifying the active record as Corruption. Appearance, evil alignment, faction, ancestry, necrotic damage, ordinary poison or a suggestive name does not supply that predicate.

Creature mode: a willing recipient receives automatic removal; an unwilling recipient makes CON against the spell DC, success resisting all of this cast's removal on that creature, failure allowing the following purge. Area mode applies the same independent willingness/save procedure to each creature occupant, while environmental records do not receive a creature's save. Resolve hidden willingness/protection/records only after legal costs, without an extra diagnostic report. For an admitted creature, end every actual qualifying removable Corruption effect currently on it, including all ordinary Corrupted condition sources and major nonintrinsic Corruption applications. This is not limited to one record or only minor records like Corruption Cleanse. A source calling its corruption permanent or giving it no ordinary expiry does not alone make it immune to this expressly stronger purge.

An explicit source-specific removal exception still governs: a unique record stating that only a named cure can remove it, that it cannot be cleansed by magic, or another actual protection applicable to this purge is not silently overridden by a generic higher rank. Keep the record and its exact unmet exception; do not relabel it minor, remove its hidden parent or claim whole-person purification. Innate ancestry, a class engine, intrinsic Oracle Curse/Burden and actual physiological changes that are now completed consequences rather than ongoing removable effects are not reclassified as targets. Corruption/Unity Exposure numeric tracks are not automatically active effect records; this spell supplies no unprinted track reset, historical alignment reversal, trait removal, HP healing, Wound cure, stabilization or resurrection. A separately actually purgeable track source could supply its own explicit procedure, which must be recorded rather than inferred.

NEW for ordinary spatially divisible environmental Corruption, remove the operative intersection inside the sphere while retaining the same source's outside extent and actual remaining clock. This expressly broader area completion is separate from lower Cleanse's minor/whole-extent rule. A genuinely indivisible or specially protected environmental source needs its own actual removal eligibility and complete required extent; an overlapping corner does not destroy an entire distant dungeon engine. Remove all admitted environmental records in the snapshot, not merely one chosen symptom. Source-specific automatic future reapplication retains its actual schedule; the purge grants no grace period, continuing aura or immunity and does not destroy a separate generator unless that generator itself was an eligible selected effect. Take one pre-removal snapshot after interrupts and apply its real source dependencies in stable source/application order. completeCatalogCard.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.duration: Instantaneous
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.
completeAuthoredCard.newChoices: NEW: fixed sphere, minute concentration and endpoint-based prevention, with atomic group failure and separate casting range and radius.
historicalWorkedCases: Both teleport endpoints outside the sphere permit transit even if a straight line between them crosses the sphere.
A portal can remain visible while its endpoint is blocked. A transit defeated after commitment leaves the traveler and real gear at the origin, with costs spent.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; concentration up to one minute. NEW: create a visible nonphysical warding plane up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick on supported ground. Every point must be within range and line of effect when created. Its thickness cannot overlap an occupied body or forcibly relocate one. Only an actual active Corrupted condition, or a source record explicitly granting equivalent mechanical eligibility, makes a creature affected. Appearance, ancestry, faction, alignment, spell tags and unrelated disease do not establish that predicate. Suppressed eligibility does not qualify while suppressed. The plane blocks affected creatures’ voluntary or forced physical crossing, including carriage, stopping that movement at the boundary. A teleport destination overlapping its thickness is blocked; a fitting destination beyond it does not cross a physical path and is allowed unless another rule prevents transport. It supplies no support against unsupported Falling; such falling can cross with the same contact damage and continues normally. The first attempted physical crossing or blocked destination contact per creature per numbered round deals 2d6 radiant, with a CON save for half rounded down; passing does not bypass the barrier. Across overlapping barriers use the earliest eligible active application for that event and one spell-family contact packet per creature per round. Exposure is spent even if defenses prevent all damage. Outside initiative use consecutive six-second intervals anchored to the first contact, preserving the open interval on entering initiative. A simultaneous group contact shares one damage roll, with separate saves and defenses. Nonmatching creatures, objects and attacks pass. There is no sight obstruction, cover, universal physical wall, diagnostic report or harvestable substance. Going around an edge remains possible; standing near the wall adds no tick. The caster is affected if eligible.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes a CHA save. NEW: a willing creature can elect failure before the roll. Success causes no application; failure establishes a nonconcentration lock lasting 24 elapsed hours. Record each currently defined effective canonical alignment axis; undefined axes remain undefined and unprotected. While operative, the lock prevents a recorded effective value from being replaced by a different one. It neither reveals values nor compels conduct. Underlying progression, Corrupted and other independent records continue to change and remain recorded, but a locked axis exposes its fixed value to mechanical alignment queries until the lock ends. Display-only masks retain their own rules and do not become actual state changes. NEW: use the earliest active eligible lock for each axis; later conflicting applications retain their own snapshots and deadlines but are suppressed for that axis. Ending exposes the current underlying state without restoring an old baseline or erasing another source’s record. Suppression retains the clock and can expose underlying changes without replaying them when the lock resumes. A prevented transition does not refund a paid cost or queue a later free attempt. Explicit absolute-source exceptions and information protections retain their scope. This grants no moral judgment, oath override or personality restriction.

CURRENT INTERFACE — NEW scoped exception `AC4-ALIGN-01` for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor versus reviewed Alignment Purge/Suggestion. A Lock/Anchor application freezes only the effective defined axis value it actually snapshots; it does not delete, prevent creation of, pause, refund, or rewrite an underlying Alignment Suggestion, Alignment Purge, or independent lawful alignment record. For effective-alignment reads on a locked axis, evaluate the ordinary underlying history and reviewed Suggestion/Purge interaction (including AP-AS-01) first, then apply the active Lock/Anchor snapshot last. Thus a Purge or Suggestion cast after a lock can establish its own live record and pay/keep its own costs and clock, but cannot change the locked effective axis while that lock remains active. When a new Suggestion computes its target baseline, exclude prior Suggestion overlays and Purge overlays as AP-AS-01 already requires, and additionally exclude AC4 Lock/Anchor overlays on the target so the lock cannot become a ratchet staircase. A Purge on the Suggestion caster still affects that caster's own effective orientation normally. If Lock/Anchor is applied while Purge or Suggestion is already effective, it snapshots the currently effective defined value; later ending/suppression of the lower overlay does not alter that snapshot. When Lock/Anchor ends or is inactive because a zone was exited/suppressed, the then-live lower lawful result becomes effective immediately with its original deadline/history; no old snapshot is restored and no missed application replays. Undefined axes are never fabricated.

historicalWorkedCases: A locked axis stays at its recorded effective value while an independent underlying change is retained. Expiry exposes that current underlying record.
An undefined axis is not assigned Neutral. An observer does not automatically learn a hidden locked value.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Under the NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01 exception, also exclude all Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor overlays on this target when computing this baseline. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still supplies Neutral/Neutral, subject to that caster's own active AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshot for the final effective read. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed; an eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot applies last under AC4-ALIGN-01, without deleting, pausing or refreshing these lower records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
operational.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step. NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: effective-alignment reads evaluate this live Suggestion overlay and the reviewed AP-AS-01 Purge interaction first, then apply the eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot last. operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, one perceived creature within 120 feet and line of effect, and a Wisdom save negating the effect. NEW choose a temporary True Neutral effective-alignment overlay, not absence of alignment, general predicate suppression or a new moral classification. On a failed binary save and absent an actual applicable immunity, establish concentration for at most 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Ordinary natural 1/20 do not shift the save. Charmed-only immunity does not stop a spell that imposes no Charmed condition; a genuine broader or alignment-alteration immunity keeps its actual scope. No repeat application/ending save or daily immunity is invented.

NEW explicit undefined-record boundary: this overlay requires both real defined canonical mechanical axes; a genuinely unaligned/no-record creature or a record with an undefined axis is not converted into fabricated Neutral data. Hidden target alignment need not be known by the caster: the ordinary perceived-creature cast commits and resolves its save without a free alignment preflight; missing/undefined qualification creates no overlay and no diagnostic alignment disclosure/refund. An already True Neutral creature with both defined axes can still receive the overlay after a failed save; it can cover later independent changes while live. The lawful underlying record is never overwritten.

Use Neutral/Neutral as effective alignment for rules whose actual predicate queries current effective canonical alignment, including genuine source-qualified alignment damage/detection/item/spell requirements. Rules requiring underlying/permanent identity, actual conduct, earned lineage, acquisition snapshots or independently recorded tags continue to require those facts. There is no new feat/class/spell/item acquisition, loss, healing, RP refill, oathbreak, atonement waiver, forced belief, loyalty, command, Charm or hard-control grant. A live power rechecking effective alignment may cease/resume only under its own dependency rule; a completed independent effect is not generically undone or recast. The underlying source and used allowances survive.

NEW named exception AP-AS-01 to reviewed Alignment Suggestion, not a claim that the old card already excluded Purge: while an actual unsuppressed Purge operates, evaluate its two Neutral values after Suggestion's live fixed changed-axis values, regardless of their cast order. Purge does not delete Suggestion, stop its concentration, extend its own source deadline or alter its source rank. When casting a new Suggestion on this recipient, compute the target baseline with every previous Suggestion overlay AND every Purge overlay on that target excluded, retaining all other actually authorized underlying changes and independent effects. Snapshot the Suggestion caster's own current effective orientation normally, including a genuine Purge on the caster if present. Compute the existing one-step shifts; only genuinely changed defined axes gain fixed Suggestion values. Its no-changed-axis/no-new-replacement rule remains. Thus Purge cannot become a target-side staircase, yet a Purged caster really has Neutral/Neutral for the existing caster-side snapshot.

Independent changes remain below the overlays with their real timestamps; ending Purge exposes the current live Suggestion/underlying result, not a restored old snapshot. Ending Suggestion while Purge remains exposes only what Purge still covers. Suppression of Purge temporarily exposes the other currently lawful result while the original deadline continues; no replay, refund or new application results on resumption. One Purge-family application per target across casters: a new failed-save eligible application replaces the prior record and its unused duration, not two stacked shifts. A saved-against/countered/no-eligible-record application does not itself replace another valid record; ordinary cast-start concentration displacement is separate and is never reversed. Expiry, dispel, caster death/incapacity or loss of required concentration ends this application. An unnamed future alignment effect still needs its own actual interaction; this one named exception creates no universal priority taxonomy and interprets no cosmology.
workedCases: DI7-07-A: A paid legal cast atDC17 receives target WIS16 and two defined axes; absent actual immunity it establishes Neutral/Neutral for a concentration60 seconds. An applicable current-effective predicate reads those values. Acquired oath, class, views, conduct and ability opportunities remain unchanged. WIS17 negates with cost kept. Hidden undefined axes are not fabricated as Neutral and their absence is not disclosed by free preflight.

DI7-07-B: Target baseline is Lawful Good; another caster first establishes a Suggestion toward Chaotic Evil, recording fixed Neutral/Neutral. Purge from a separate caster then covers it. A new Good-oriented Suggestion target baseline excludes both older Suggestion and Purge; a Lawful Good caster finds no changed axes and creates no replacement. Later genuine underlying Neutral Evil change survives. End Purge while older Suggestion remains: its fixed Neutral/Neutral still applies. End that Suggestion: the lawful underlying Neutral Evil appears, not the old Lawful Good snapshot. Separate casters/actual concentration permissions are required for the fixture.

completeSharedRules.casting:
KEEP all seven actual ordinary identities as Divination rank 7, Action, V/S/F and base 17 RP, with Mass Revelation range 60 feet and the other six range 120 feet under their exact targeting interpretations below. Ordinary access is Cleric/Wizard class 13 and Mirrorsage/Shaman class 19, not total level or possession of 17 RP. Actual acquisition, repertoire/preparation, provider retention, legal action, components, body, target and current casting restrictions remain mandatory. In particular Bloodcaller's actual loss of ordinary Shaman casting is not waived; Oracle RC and other same-named class/feat/item permissions grant none of these ordinary spells. Actual class focus and S-hand compatibility apply; no costly material, generic upcast, new school placement or resource pool is invented. Read the original generating source fields without normalizing absence/null.

KEEP the reviewed ordinary sequence: verify legality; price from actual pre-cast state using the selected route and every applicable independent cost/modifier; commit costs, components, concentration transition and beginning strain/Refrain exactly once; then resolve legal interrupts and the surviving effect. Failed, protected, saved-against and countered committed casts refund nothing. Ordinary saves are binary meet-DC without natural shifts; an actual Counterspell check uses Core task degrees/natural shifts collapsed to success/failure, DC 10 + twice the triggering cast's actual rank. Generic Automatic or opposed as described creates no free save, identification roll or invented opposed DC. No information spell grants a Reaction, target sight or a new interruption trigger. Fate Echo's explicitly NEW two-commitment exception below is the only new casting bridge here; no other copy mechanism inherits it.
completeSharedRules.information:
KEEP source-authorized hidden but established world facts as readable information. An authoritative Director-established fact does not need a pre-existing software log or a caster-known document; conversely, a source file, nonempty story label or fixture is not proof of an actual campaign fact. The spell's scope authorizes disclosure, not invention of an otherwise undefined history, actor, faction or operation. Missing data is not zero, Neutral, nonmembership, absence of a trap or proof of an empty past. Preserve exact fact source, version, time precision and audience separately from the current query.

Read every unprotected fact the individual spell promises; do not reduce all activities/history to one favored record or an arbitrary sample. A specific protection applies only to the information, subject, generating school/rank and time scope it actually covers. Protection of one person does not conceal independent institutional/environmental facts, and protected personal facts cannot be relabeled institution/effect history to evade the protection. Supply independently meaningful readable fields. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden reason, number of withheld records or protection. If existence itself is protected, disclose no placeholder, ID gap, total or count derived from that protected existence. Claim No qualifying fact only where absence itself is established and readable; otherwise do not certify completeness beyond the readable facts. An explicitly permitted masking effect retains its own false/altered-result rule; do not override it with a generic truthful-result assertion.

Equivalent paid inquiries under materially unchanged facts, authority and applicable protections give consistent overlapping information across casters/rephrasing. Genuine new events, changed protections or new established evidence can change later paid answers. Knowledge itself supplies no skill success, disarm, control, consent, authority, spell acquisition or free communication. KEEP the reviewed observer-specific location rule: a revealed actual location ends Hidden for that observer and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers for that observer; it does not end Invisible or grant sight. Independent darkness, blindness, smoke and other actual modifiers remain. Communicated information requires a real channel and grants only what was actually communicated. Public teaching/procedure projection never publishes the internal fact/protection/donor dossiers or private membership merely because the rule can query them.
completeSharedRules.timeAndIdentity: KEEP exact event/cast/application identities and source-specific budgets. NEW DI7 sustained durations explicitly specified as 60 elapsed seconds begin at effect resolution, use an absolute phase-0 endpoint, and never reset on extra turns, initiative changes, absence, scene changes or transfer of a token. At that endpoint the effect is unavailable for a new event. Vision Quest's normal completion is its expressly defined completion-and-answer event, not an interruption; same-time competing events use existing timestamp/phase/application-sequence order. Existing counterpart durations, especially Alignment Suggestion's preserved marker rule, are unchanged. Suppression and restoration never replay missed notices or refund spent uses; each exact DI7 procedure states its own continuation or termination. Source death, incapacity, concentration and real suppression are distinct: no universal death-ending rule is imported into an independently attached nonconcentration ward. Keep one concentration slot except an independently acquired, actually paid source-specific exception. Hard denial, damage roots, prevention/transfer stages, real providers and material histories remain the existing rules, not a copy-created replacement engine.
completeSharedRules.examples: All examples are authored conditional adjudications, not actual campaign receipts, full spell-runtime tests or human balance evidence. Unless expressly changed, use an actually entitled single-class Wizard 13, INT +4, PB 5, actual spell DC 17 before separately applicable bonuses, maximum/current RP 48/48, a legal prepared spell, working arcane focus/S hand and audible V. Ordinary Limit is 11. The 17-RP quotations assume pre-cast Dissonance below 11 and no actual price modifiers. A first distinct prepared matrix may waive only its own base strain; its actual encounter history must be specified. A Fate Echo nested copy is the NEW copied-spell route, not another prepared matrix. Explicit example state is a conditional premise, not proof that an arbitrary character has those features, resources, targets or world facts.
completeSharedRules.deferredBoundary: DI7-02 Greater Planar Summons retains two extraplanar allies, CR8 each, Action/120ft/concentration up to1minute/base17RP and every original access row. No operational ally profile, origin, plane, consent, arrival, return or cosmological interpretation is supplied before authorized push and verified remote.
completeSharedRules.shamanCastingInterface:
DI7-SHAMAN-VENT-01 — Shaman vent checkpoint. Evaluate the Shaman’s once-per-round ordinary-spell totem vent at casting-sequence step 5, after step 4 has committed the cast and established any required concentration, ending incompatible prior concentration. Use the caster’s actual position, the actual ownership and active state of the totem aura, this cast’s qualifying ordinary Shaman spell route, and that Shaman’s existing once-per-round use history at this checkpoint. Do not retain a pre-commit aura snapshot.

The first qualifying ordinary spell cast while inside at least one of that Shaman’s own still-active totem auras automatically occupies the round’s opportunity and generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. This remains the first qualifying cast even when its generated Dissonance was already 0; it does not remove accumulated Dissonance or preserve the opportunity for a later spell. An earlier cast outside an own active aura, or through an excluded route, does not occupy this opportunity.

Establishing incompatible concentration at step 4 ends the shared totem burden and its auras before this determination. That cast therefore receives no totem vent and does not occupy the first-inside opportunity. A later counter, failed result, aura restoration or movement does not replay the checkpoint, refund an occupied opportunity or restore displaced concentration. Multiple own overlapping totems provide only one reduction and share the Shaman’s one round opportunity; another Shaman’s aura does not qualify.

An ordinary Fate Echo outer cast may qualify independently. Its fate-echo-copy child is not an ordinary learned Shaman spell and neither receives nor occupies this ordinary-spell-only vent. A concentration-requiring child ends incompatible totems at its own commitment, without undoing the outer cast’s earlier valid vent. A readied outer cast must account for its actual held-spell concentration; a nonconcentration payload does not exempt its Ready hold from concentration displacement. Release supplies no second outer casting or vent checkpoint.

The vent grants no RP reduction, does not revise already committed RP, and cannot bypass pre-commit casting restrictions. Fate’s required forecast and later child revalidation still use the actual chronological strain and resource state under their existing rules. The existing source-governed round boundary remains unchanged.

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive with line of effect, including yourself. Actual range is 30 feet when cast through Abjuration rank 1, or 60 feet through Conjuration rank 3; the 60-foot header is the maximum across these modes.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. For each incoming attack roll, compare the attacker's explicit current canonical alignment with the protected recipient's explicit current canonical alignment.
operational.effect: Grant +2 AC against attack rolls from a creature explicitly opposed to the protected recipient on at least one alignment axis: Lawful versus Chaotic, or Good versus Evil. Neutral is not opposite to any value. An unknown or missing axis supplies no opposition; a known exact opposite on another axis still qualifies. Both class-specific modes use this same bounded bonus.
operational.scaling: None. Only your casting class's listed school/rank mode is available; higher level or extra RP cannot switch modes.
operational.limitations: Never infer alignment from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or behavior. The bonus does not identify or announce the attacker's alignment; observers may make ordinary deductions from visible results. The spectral shield creates no equipment, item HP, hand requirement, cover, projectile blocking, saleable object or immunity. It does not affect saving throws or automatically hitting effects. Use only the strongest applicable flat AC bonus. Other concurrent shields retain their own endpoints and concentration dependencies. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: Abjuration Instantaneous becomes concentration 1 minute; Conjuration blocks-attacks prose uses +2 AC rather than immunity. completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; concentration up to one minute. Require actual membership in a recorded faction and actual invocation permission; favorable standing alone is insufficient. NEW: summon one willing temporary faction-affiliated ally using the complete Faction Envoy profile below, in a perceived fitting unoccupied supported space with line of effect. The profile is designed for the source’s nominal CR 3 role; balance and CR certification remain open. The current public CR-3 entries do not establish both finished mechanics and this caster’s faction relationship; their original profiles remain comparison evidence. Temporary affiliation grants no institutional membership, credentials, secrets, reputation or alignment. Member-only benefits require actual separate membership evidence. The Envoy acts immediately after your regular turn under the actual Bonus Action command and shared offensive-action allowance, using only the profile’s listed actions. Without a command it can move defensively and Dodge. One Envoy per caster; successful replacement or concentration/source ending removes the old body. Ordinary non-Null damage that reaches 0 invokes the finite-summon endpoint and removes it; qualifying Null damage instead uses the Disabled-at-0 rule below. Real borrowed cargo drops legally without duplication; its conjured blade vanishes. Suppression preserves the same body, HP and deadline without actions, healing or a fresh summon event until resumption. No autonomous attack, loot, corpse, soul/resource reward, free Help or unknown faction information is granted. This summons one finite body; it does not requisition a real NPC or publish Director-only traits.

CURRENT FACTION INTERFACE — `caster faction` requires actual recorded membership in one exact canonical faction AND actual source/campaign invocation permission under the reviewed Faction Seal permission procedure. Affiliation, favorable `standing-v1`, disguise, information access, or the Envoy's temporary descriptor cannot substitute for either gate. Faction Sanctuary's caster invocation permission remains its own gate and does not itself make a Sanctuary recipient a member. The temporary Envoy's `faction-affiliated` descriptor is source-limited to this summon and is not institutional membership; it cannot satisfy member-only Sanctuary, credentials, reputation, or access.

CURRENT NULL/LIFECYCLE INTERFACE — A qualifying `nullNonlethal=true` damage root that reduces this finite summoned companion from positive HP to 0, or later strikes that same already-`Null Disabled 0` body, does not end, replace or reapply the body/state. Use the accepted `finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast` branch: the same identity becomes `Null Disabled 0` (Incapacitated, Speed 0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands) while the original spell/concentration/deadline continues. Independent concentration end, duration expiry, dismissal or replacement still ends the body. A real healing source whose targeting applies under NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01 can raise it above 0 and end Disabled; no generic free heal, resummon refresh, or corpse/loot is created.

historicalWorkedCases: The Envoy’s two attack components use one commanded offensive Action, leaving no shared offensive allowance for another companion that round.
Favorable reputation alone does not authorize this cast without actual faction membership and invocation permission.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.
completeSharedRules.summonTargeting: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: solely for the two authored AC4 temporary profiles Summon Water Pet and Faction Envoy, while their finite body exists they count as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

/factionAllyProfile.status: NEW summon-only profile for the source’s nominal CR 3 role; no human CR/balance certification.
/factionAllyProfile.type: Humanoid for mechanical targeting only; no new ancestry or setting origin.
/factionAllyProfile.checks: Use the actual ability modifier without additional proficiency. Ordinary sight/hearing; understands the caster’s spoken commands through this spell only, without other languages, telepathy or faction intelligence. No resistances, immunities, spells, slots, class features or special senses.
/factionAllyProfile.attack: One commanded offensive Action makes two melee weapon attacks, +5 to hit, reach 5 feet, each dealing 1d8+3 slashing. Each target must be legal when attacked. Movement between attacks uses the same actual 30-foot movement budget. A critical doubles only the die. No ranged attack or ammunition is supplied. The temporary one-handed blade is nontransferable: separation makes it vanish without supplying another wielder, material or value.
/factionAllyProfile.actions: A Bonus Action command from the owner, within 60 feet and perceived through actual senses, permits movement and the two-attack offensive Action OR one ordinary Dodge, Dash, Disengage or Search. No item activation, casting, Help, grapple, shove, healing or independent opportunity attack. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge. It shares the owner’s command/offense allowance; extra turns create no additional offense.
/factionAllyProfile.lifecycle: One entity and HP pool, without refresh from commands, transfer or suppression. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the source finite-summon endpoint and ends the body. Qualifying Null-nonlethal damage reaching 0 instead uses the accepted finite-summon Null Disabled0 branch while concentration/deadline remains; independent concentration/source ending, replacement or dismissal still ends it. A real healing/repair source must expressly apply to raise a Disabled Envoy above0; no generic free recovery. Real entrusted cargo drops legally on ending. No conjured stock, corpse, reward, harvest, permanent recruitment or faction standing. Qualifying Null damage reaching 0 or later striking the same already-Disabled0 body preserves that body/state with no death/loot/new clock/reapplication. Independent concentration end, expiry, dismissal or replacement still ends it.
/factionAllyProfile.targetingClassification: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: while this finite body exists, mechanically eligible as an active creature and living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. No natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, undead/construct or cosmological identity is inferred.

completeCatalogCard.name: Faction Portal

operational.targets: One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.
operational.effect:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

completeCatalogCard.name: Planar Window

operational.targets: One local fixed point or surface you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, plus one intended specific location on a known plane other than your current plane.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Identify the remote location through prior personal visitation or a reliable map, description or established source that uniquely identifies it. Knowing a plane alone does not identify a site; no universal corresponding coordinates are invented. After costs commit, resolve the actual destination and applicable planar/information wards. If the remote designation has no usable viewpoint or is blocked, no readable remote information is supplied and no hidden reason is diagnosed. Neither viewpoint may occupy solid matter. The local point must have room for a nonphysical 5-foot-wide by 5-foot-high window.
operational.effect: Create one fixed visible 5-by-5-foot viewing window. It displays ordinary vision from the fixed remote point in all directions; observers may direct their attention around that scene without moving the remote point. Anyone who can ordinarily see the local window can see the unprotected displayed scene. Local Blindness, actual visual obstructions and inability to see the window prevent this viewing. Remote light, darkness, smoke, walls and terrain work normally; the spell grants no darkvision or true sight. Separately, you privately detect the location and category of actual native beings and native ongoing effects/phenomena within 30 feet and line of effect of the remote point. Native means a genuine established native/origin relationship to that plane, supported by actual source or setting fiction. This added detection can locate a readable Hidden/Invisible native presence without providing sight of its body. A visitor or a spell merely cast there by a visitor is not thereby native. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. The additional detection does not reveal an otherwise unseen entity solely because its provenance is undefined. Protected presence/location/category fields remain protected independently.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Only you receive native-detection reports; other observers receive the displayed ordinary vision. That private magical detection does not require your eyes or continued sight of the local window, but concentration and the remote 30-foot/line-of-effect limits still apply. Neither point moves, follows a creature/vehicle or searches rooms; ordinary translation of a chosen supporting surface does not carry the fixed window. No continuing 60-foot caster tether is added after legal placement, and no clock pauses on caster travel or suppression. One Planar Window per caster; successful recasting replaces it. Specific planar or information protections filter only their actual scope. The window is nonphysical magic, not a break in either barrier: no sound, passage, physical interaction, attack, remote target permission, line of effect or casting origin is supplied in either direction. It has no HP or harvestable surface and is affected only by an actually applicable detection/suppression/dispel rule. Suppression supplies no backlog or replay. The source’s remote visual scene is public, but it creates no recording object. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F, vision into another plane and detection of native beings/effects. CONFLICT RULING: raw 60 feet is local placement; NEW concentration up to one minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: known remote location, fixed 5-by-5 public vision, private 30-foot native detection. Exact completions bound unknown-provenance reports to otherwise observed presences, distinguish private detection from eyesight, and add no unprinted continuing caster tether.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, numerical balance and broader system validation pending
